# src/ai

Compiled from `contracts/rules`. Change a rule there (`npm run learn -- ...`), never here.

- **invariant** `ai/generate-only-category-catalog-already-carries`: Generate only a category the catalog already carries, and widen that allowlist at no point during generation. It is what guarantees a generated graphic is operable in the control panel through the same machine, fields and events as a hand-picked one, because the same `variant.create()` the wizard runs assembled it.
- **invariant** `ai/let-catalog-design-code-reach-any`: Let NO catalog design code reach any CREATE prompt. The anti-anchoring rule is absolute: a coder arm studies `neutralSkeleton.ts` instead, and `e2e/creative-pilot.spec.ts` covers it.
- **trap** `ai/bound-appended-css-root-inner-html`: Bound `applyPolish` to appended CSS and the root's inner HTML; reject changes to `:root`, `@font-face`, scripts, field ids or animation selectors. Run `polishStage` only for a requested `flourish` on a valid assembly and revert a rejected or bench-failing patch.
- **trap** `ai/check-before-using-retrieval-latter-deliberately`: Check `anchorResolves` before using `variantSatisfiesAnchor` in retrieval; the latter deliberately accepts unresolved anchors for satisfaction checks. Return `FULL_CATALOG` when no anchor resolves, drop an empty field bucket and fall back to catalog order when no query signal survives.
- **trap** `ai/choose-fallback-entries-successful-real-calls`: Choose fallback entries in `AI_MODELS` from successful real calls, not model listings alone; a listed id is no proof that an account can use it. Preserve account-availability failures as actionable errors rather than claiming discovery can filter them away.
- **trap** `ai/finish-deterministic-image-baking-before-runs`: Finish deterministic image `src` baking before `assetIntegrityFindings` runs through `productionSpxValidator`; `targetsOf` locates protected pictures through their `<img src>`. Treat this as a CSS-text screen, not a resolved-cascade proof.
- **trap** `ai/keep-injected-run-routed-results-surface`: Keep `GenerateOptions.structuralCheck` injected and run it on routed results; surface `structural-intent` parts findings as warnings and `structural-kind` findings as blocking errors on grounded output. Report the resolved `variantId` from `groundedResult` so validation and refinement describe the assembled graphic.
- **trap** `ai/keep-same-retrieved-set-every-shown`: Keep `catalogDigest(only?)` and `narrowVariantTool` on the same retrieved set so every shown `variantId` is legal. Preserve the full digest on CREATE and let `stubProvider` choose deterministically from the same shortlist.
- **trap** `ai/pass-assembly-policy-arguments-never-infer`: Pass `keepChassisZone` and `sizeScaleRange` as assembly policy arguments to `groundedResult`, never infer Lite from `profile` inside it. Keep compilation clamps aligned with the caller's declared schema.
- **trap** `ai/pass-attachment-context-through-referenced-images`: Pass attachment context through `modify` to `toTemplate` so referenced images are bundled. Merge existing and newly attached images by path in `contextFrom`, and do not force code-level refinement merely because an image was attached.
- **trap** `ai/preserve-model-original-javascript-cannot-produce`: Preserve the model's original JavaScript when `convertEmittedRegion` cannot produce readable `NOACG_ANIM`; demote residual `bench-editability` findings for fresh free-form output. Keep editability blocking when a modify started from a template with readable animation data.
- **trap** `ai/preserve-stored-ids-change-their-display`: Preserve `AI_TIERS` stored ids `lite`, `pro` and `custom` in `spx-gfx-ai`; change their display labels without renaming persisted values.
- **trap** `ai/retrieve-during-using-request-plus-current`: Retrieve during `specRefine` using the request plus the current spec's identity and content, and pin its `variantId` with `ShortlistOptions.keep`. Match the incumbent against the anchor rather than the narrowed pool, and refuse a `keep` from another structure.
- **trap** `ai/state-which-platform-faults-were-live`: State which platform faults were live when drawing conclusions from a benchmark round, and rebaseline when its harness changes. Check the measuring instrument before attributing a defect to model capability.
- **trap** `ai/treat-regex-screen-obvious-constructs-containment`: Treat `safetyFindings` as a regex screen for obvious constructs, not containment; code such as `window['fetc'+'h']` can evade it. Do not claim a same-origin runtime preview is isolated by this check.
- **trap** `ai/wrap-injected-validator-findings-reach-repair`: Wrap the injected validator with `withSafetyChecks` so findings reach repair, and screen displayed results again with `mergeSafety` because `generateRaw` bypasses that validator. Pass the modify/convert `source` to preserve pre-existing construct categories; fresh generation passes no source.
- **rule** `ai/apply-compositional-changes-through-marked-css`: Apply compositional changes through `applyDesignAdjustments` as marked CSS overrides, preserve house contracts and guard each adjustment on the target structure existing.
- **rule** `ai/assemble-catalog-chassis-drawn-zone-answer`: Assemble a catalog chassis at its drawn zone with `AssembleOptions.keepChassisZone`; answer side requests through `variant.defaultZone` in retrieval rather than design-name text. Use a differently anchored catalog member when the requested side changes.
- **rule** `ai/assemble-catalog-fit-values-through-clamp`: Assemble catalog-fit `DesignSpec` values through `specToTemplate` and `variant.create`; clamp out-of-range parameters to their legal bounds and give the project brand palette precedence.
- **rule** `ai/assess-lite-pro-against-their-own`: Assess Lite and Pro against their own purposes and benchmarks; do not treat success in one as evidence for the other. Share `AiSettings.tier`, the user brief and `pro/brief.ts` mapping deliberately without creating a parallel brief vocabulary.
- **rule** `ai/build-browse-ranking-engine-shared-structural`: Build `shortlistFor` with the Browse ranking engine in `src/templates/search.ts` and the shared structural anchor table, using the brief and existing intent without another model call. Weight terms by rarity, cut relative to the best match, fill the floor in bands, and make `Shortlist.reason` distinguish matches from top-ups.
- **rule** `ai/build-offline-results-through-preserving-same`: Build offline `stubProvider` results through `DesignSpec` and `specToTemplate`, preserving `applySpecLocks` and the same deterministic setup post-passes so structured creation stays testable without tokens.
- **rule** `ai/bundle-only-pictures-through-keep-pictures`: Bundle only `asset` pictures through `GenerateContext.images`; keep `layout`, `mood` and `plate` pictures vision-only in `GenerateContext.references` as `{asset, use}`. Use `fixedAssetPaths` to keep permanent assets out of operator fields.
- **rule** `ai/carry-through-typed-data-preserving-model`: Carry `GenerationSpec` through `GenerateContext.spec` as typed data, preserving its model-layer persistence as `aiSpec`. Let `specIsEmpty` make empty setup inject nothing through `specSections`, so prompt-only callers retain the same prompt.
- **rule** `ai/drive-matrix-brief-bank-through-application`: Drive the `benchmarks/video/v1` matrix and brief bank through `src/ai/video` in the application, never through benchmark-only model prompts. Follow `docs/VIDEO_MODEL_BENCHMARK.md` for comparable runs and artifacts.
- **rule** `ai/ground-spx-definition-field-ids-auto`: Ground the SPX definition, field ids, `:root`, auto-fit, zones, `NOACG_ANIM` and export readiness in platform code; leave visual decisions to the brief within the selected route's contract.
- **rule** `ai/honor-explicit-values-let-choose-create`: Honor explicit `GenerateOptions.mode` values; let `auto` choose CREATE from evidenced originality, unresolved structure, low confidence or `intent.beyondScope`. Narrow the tool with `narrowFitTool` when routing requires it and retain the decision in `AiTemplateChange.routing`, `intent` and telemetry.
- **rule** `ai/keep-call-format-basics-static-only`: Keep `generateRaw` to one call with `RAW_SYSTEM`, format basics and static `validateTemplate` only; add no worked example, taste teaching, runtime bench or repair loop. This path is the comparison baseline.
- **rule** `ai/keep-catalog-grounded-return-typed-failures`: Keep `profile: 'lite'` catalog-grounded and return typed `LiteRequestError` failures for unsupported raw generation, import conversion or code repair; never silently fall back to a more expensive coder. Keep `normalizeLiteSpec` pinned to catalog fit with no `flourish`.
- **rule** `ai/keep-dependency-light-browser-api-typescript`: Keep `lite/types.ts` and `pro/types.ts` dependency-light so browser and API TypeScript trees can share the wire vocabulary; do not import catalog or DOM-bearing model modules into them.
- **rule** `ai/keep-paid-runs-out-they-require`: Keep paid `scripts/ai-compare.mjs` and `scripts/ai-bench.mjs` runs out of CI; they require a dev server and real credentials and spend model tokens.
- **rule** `ai/keep-proposal-only-behind-never-auto`: Keep `imported-graphic-analysis` proposal-only behind `AI_TASK_IMPORT_ANALYSIS_ENABLED`; never auto-apply, generate code or invent a parallel representation. Apply accepted suggestions through the same transforms manual Import Graphic placement uses.
- **rule** `ai/keep-provider-specific-transport-below-through`: Keep provider-specific transport below `AIProvider` through `modelTypes.ts` and `modelGateway.ts`; normalize structured output, usage, costs, errors, retries and explicit fallbacks at the gateway seam. Make `modelCatalog.ts` consume the normalized server discovery endpoint.
- **rule** `ai/keep-reporting-instrument-treat-finding-shipped`: Keep `tasteCheck.ts` a reporting instrument; treat a finding on a shipped design as a question about the criterion, never permission to move its threshold.
- **rule** `ai/keep-transport-vocabulary-user-key-subset`: Keep `AI_PROVIDER_IDS` as the transport vocabulary and `AI_PROVIDERS` as the user-key subset `openai`, `anthropic`, `google`, `huggingface`. Move a stored managed route to `DEFAULT_BYOK_PROVIDER` when resolving the `custom` tier so it cannot spend NoaCG's key.
- **rule** `ai/keep-validation-repair-preference-learning-graphic`: Keep `DesignSpec`, validation, repair, preference learning and graphic-type context outside provider adapters; add providers below `AIProvider` without forking the harness. Follow `docs/AI_PROVIDER_GATEWAY.md` for gateway and credential handling.
- **rule** `ai/keep-wizard-route-pro-generation-composed`: Keep `pro/language/pipeline.ts` as the wizard's route to Pro generation and `pro/language/gate.ts` as the composed-output validation seam. Generate a design language once and compose requested graphics from that language through the platform.
- **rule** `ai/measure-defect-dimension-before-claiming-deterministic`: Measure a defect's dimension before claiming a deterministic gate catches it; otherwise forbid the construct. Do not equate a machine-valid template with a good graphic.
- **rule** `ai/offer-managed-pro-only-reports-hosted`: Offer managed Pro only when `GET /api/ai/pro-status` reports hosted availability and `isBackendConfigured()` holds; preserve `proOffered = proHosted && isBackendConfigured()`. Keep unavailable Pro absent, add no client Pro flag, and never substitute a customer-key request for managed service.
- **rule** `ai/pass-bounded-oldest-first-caller-render`: Pass bounded, oldest-first `GenerateContext.conversation` from the caller and render it in `contextText`, `modifyContent` and `specRefine`; the provider must not reread a UI session. Use `seed` in fresh generation as a direction to vary, never as three tints of the previous result.
- **rule** `ai/persist-only-non-secret-provider-model`: Persist only non-secret provider, model and routing preferences plus server-reported credential availability in `settings.ts`; never place raw keys in localStorage.
- **rule** `ai/preserve-custom-coder-catalog-example-repair`: Preserve the custom coder's catalog example, `designNotes`, `coderSystemPrompt` and repair policy when changing routing; routing changes which briefs reach the control, not what it sees. Document deliberate control changes and rebaseline comparisons across them.
- **rule** `ai/read-before-proposing-apparently-new-approach`: Read `docs/AI_ATTEMPTS.md` before proposing an apparently new AI approach, and distinguish live product paths from experiments and retired mechanisms.
- **rule** `ai/record-stage-timings-api-reported-tokens`: Record stage timings, API-reported tokens, repair rounds, routing and diversity through `startAiRun` in the local `telemetry.ts` ring, retaining JSON export. Separate SPX statistics from `video-generate` and `video-refine` using `AiRunKind`.
- **rule** `ai/require-comparison-evidence-before-adding-selective`: Require comparison evidence before adding a selective vision taste critic, curated taste retrieval or nightly taste-analysis proposals; never let a critic automatically rewrite a valid grounded result.
- **rule** `ai/require-harness-earn-reliability-quality-advantage`: Require the harness to earn its reliability and quality advantage over a plain model call in `scripts/ai-compare.mjs`; retain a stage only when its improvement justifies its cost.
- **rule** `ai/return-failed-generation-results-validation-attached`: Return failed generation results with validation attached and keep grounded assembly failures out of model repair. Use `GenerateOptions.validate` through `validateWith` for the general harness and surface a failing `groundedResult` as a platform defect.
- **rule** `ai/run-before-design-call-using-fast`: Run `intentAndRoute` before the design call in `generate` and `generateAlternatives`, using `emit_structural_intent` on the fast model and deterministic `normalizeIntent`/`routeIntent`. Skip that stage for explicit `adapt`, Lite, raw and modify.
- **rule** `ai/run-before-paid-lite-import-analysis`: Run `npm run bench:preflight -- <models>` before paid Lite or import-analysis comparison rounds and resolve arms through the real `liteProfile` and task registry in `api/_lib/aiBenchPreflight.ts`. Refuse overridden, unapproved, unconfigured or indistinguishable arms before spending.
- **rule** `ai/share-community-checks-agree-about-network`: Share `unsafeJsConstructs` from `src/validation/templateBench.ts` in `safetyFindings` so AI and community checks agree about network calls, storage, runtime code construction and cross-frame access. Treat findings as blocking errors.
- **rule** `ai/stage-pick-commit-through-project-created`: Stage a pick with `stageSelection` and commit it through `commitStagedSelection` when the project is created; store only local shown/chosen facet counters. Let `preferenceHint` act as a subtle tie-breaker after `MIN_SELECTIONS` and `MIN_SHOWN`, never override the brief or react to a single click.
- **rule** `ai/teach-free-form-motion-authoring-grammar`: Teach free-form motion in the authoring grammar using `emitPresetRegion`, then pass every emit through `convertEmittedRegion` and `convertToDataRegion`. Require the structure spine `<div class="PREFIX">`, a single-class `<div class="PREFIX-box">`, `PREFIX-mask` around each `#fN`, and `PREFIX-accent` that conversion relies on.
- **rule** `ai/treat-managed-tier-cost-target-route`: Treat a managed tier's cost target as a route constraint, never a customer charge; change the model route when the target is missed.
- **rule** `ai/use-bounded-errors-back-cycle-default`: Use `repairLoop` for the bounded errors-back cycle, with `MAX_REPAIR_ROUNDS` as its default budget and revalidation after every emit. Inject each caller's blocking policy while sending the complete current error list to `reEmit`; return the final validation even when repair fails.
- **rule** `ai/use-name-hugging-face-credentials-tokens`: Use `credentialNoun` to name Hugging Face credentials as tokens, and preserve the `huggingface` provider's `credential: 'token'` vocabulary.
- **rule** `ai/use-shared-vocabulary-variant-satisfaction-keep`: Use `src/templates/structuralAnchor.ts` as the shared vocabulary for `resolveAnchor`, `structuralFit`, `intentCoversFrame` and variant satisfaction; keep `GraphicType.structuralScope` authoritative for excluded structures. Do not create an AI-owned copy that validation would need to import.
- **rule** `ai/use-spec-level-only-while-still`: Use `GenerateOptions.spec` for spec-level `modify` only while `detectPrefix` and `parseAnimData` still recognize a house-shaped template; otherwise refine code. Feed `convertImport` a deterministically parsed import from `src/model/importTemplate.ts`, never raw file bytes.
- **taste** `ai/describe-tiers-their-user-outcome-without`: Describe the `lite` and `pro` tiers by their user outcome, without vendor, model or transport names; keep managed-service plumbing out of tier labels.
- **taste** `ai/let-brief-references-define-taste-teach`: Let the brief and references define taste; teach contextual reasoning in `TASTE_REASONING` and `specSystemPrompt`, not a fixed house aesthetic. Treat uploaded references as a design system that outweighs generic style advice.
- **taste** `ai/make-different-briefs-produce-different-designs`: Make different briefs produce different designs; assess sameness with the top-chassis counter in `scripts/ai-compare.mjs`, not palette variation alone.
- **taste** `ai/read-references-composition-hierarchy-without-copying`: Read `layout` references for composition and hierarchy without copying artwork, `mood` for look and motion energy without borrowing layout, and `plate` for legibility and safe placement without placing or imitating the background. Treat a sketch as a construction diagram in `attachmentSections`.
- **taste** `ai/write-catalog-adaptations-express-two-text`: Write `LITE_EXAMPLE_PROMPTS` for catalog adaptations and express the two text lines as an explicit stack; do not promise a new palette or placement the chassis will discard. Write `PRO_EXAMPLE_PROMPTS` in the design language's look dimensions and verify examples by generating and inspecting their frames.
- **taste** `ai/write-design-constraints-inspection-criteria-make`: Write design constraints as inspection criteria and make absence their first failure; avoid teaching only lists of named failures. When a teaching change shifts behavior, examine its framing before changing the rule.
